facts.why: Not a Poe line. His best-known line is 'Put the bunny back in the box.' (said to Billy Bedlam). Printed in quote marks and signed Cameron Poe. If this fix is used, the house line 'Put the bunny back in the box.' needs a new note.
facts.fix: Put the bunny back in the box.
